conversion_signals.label: Audit export

conversion_signals.label: External memory governance

rules: Inspector Pro components have clear separate license headers
NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES are maintained when needed
paid backend does not silently relicense open-core contributions
external_connector_rules: treat external memory as optional connector, not source of truth
show component name, source URL, version, and license before install
require explicit Enable or Install action
preserve license and NOTICE obligations when redistributing or bundling
include connector status in reports and metrics
never allow external memory to override code, tests, evidence, or decisions
warn in team mode when memory is shared across worktrees or cannot be isolated
provide disable/uninstall and audit view in paid implementation
